title: Post-Training for Tabular Language Models
summary: A reference implementation of TabGRAA, an iterative reward-guided post-training framework that fine-tunes tabular language-model generators (e.g., GReaT/DistilGPT-2) via group-relative advantage alignment and DPO/NPO/KTO baselines, with a full evaluation suite for fidelity, utility, detection, and privacy. Its RDT HyperTransformer/encoders preprocess tabular columns and SDMetrics' QualityReport and LogisticDetection are called directly in the evaluation scripts to score synthetic data quality and detectability.
